chapter: Apollo years, Eubie Blake and failing eyesight
title: Last years with Duke and going blind in February 1972
summary: He stayed with the band until 1971, and describes the moment the veil dropped in a doctor's office in February 1972.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Sure, I was there. I was in the band until '80, '81.
Yea, '71, I was there until '71 and I went blind in '72.
Oh, you did, you lost your sight in 1972.
Yeah, February 23rd, right in the doctor's office, the veil went down.
February 23rd. '72. I was right in the office and I had been going to this doctor trying to, you know, and the curtain went on down. I said, well, I can't see now.
He didn't say nothing. Said are you putting anything in your eyes.
Was this doctor, downtown or up in Harlem.

Dr.Towle, right at 72nd Street and Park Avenue. So he couldn't do nothing. None of these doctors could do anything for me, because I went up there at the Medical Center and that doctor up there, he was giving me drops but they didn't seem to work and I had glasses and Radio City, there, I used to go in that opticians there and they used to examine my eyes and give me glasses.
